Type.evidence_source: A reflexive approach was applied throughout the research process to ensure the rigor of the study and its findings. That is, the researchers continually reflected on their own preconceptions and impressions and contemplated how these may influence the quality and interpretation of the data collected. Further enhancing the rigor of the study, credibility was achieved by all members of the research team independently analysing the data and discussing individual findings until consensus was reached (Polit & Beck, 2010).
